description: This file defines the 'FieldObject' class which implements a component of the mini-language parsing framework in the Ofbiz project. It handles extraction and type management of field data within the mini-language execution context.

classes.name: FieldObject
classes.description: A class that represents a field within the mini-language, capable of retrieving and typing the value of a specified field.

methods.name: FieldObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FieldObject instance based on an XML element and the current method context.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified field from the runtime environment map.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Returns the Java Class object corresponding to the field's type.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the type of the field.
